exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Trying out something".

options.text: A とか B とか
Verb てみる (〜te miru)
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb てみる (〜te miru) matches "Trying out something".

exercises.explanation: Used to say you try doing something to see what happens.
